item.title: Asus' latest OLED gaming monitor combines RGB stripe tech and Tandem OLED
item.description: In traditional OLED panels, subpixels can be arranged in various configurations, which can sometimes cause subtle text fringing or uneven color reproduction. With RGB stripes, the red, green, and blue subpixels align vertically in a linear pattern similar to that seen on LCDs.Read Entire Article

item.title: Google is putting even more AI into Gmail, and some of it is on by default

item.title: HWiNFO delivers deep hardware insights and sensor monitoring
item.description: HWiNFO is designed to report detailed hardware information alongside real-time monitoring of system sensors. It reports granular data for CPUs, GPUs, memory, storage, and motherboards, including temperatures, clock speeds, voltages, power draw, and throttling behavior.Read Entire Article
